tasks.instruction: Wykorzystujac slowa podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij luki w zdaniach tak, aby zachowac sens zdania wyjsciowego. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac do 6 wyrazow lacznie z wyrazem juz podanym. Nie wolno zmieniac form podanych slow. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna.

items.original: I could not leave the island because of the strike of air traffic controllers.
items.transformed: I _________ the island because of the strike of air traffic controllers.

items.original: We will not get there in less than an hour.
items.transformed: It _________ an hour to get there.

items.original: Despite knowing the city quite well I got lost.
items.transformed: _________ the city quite well, I got lost.

items.original: "We can watch any of these films," she said.
items.transformed: She told us that _________ which film we saw.
items.answer: it did not (didn't) matter to her

items.original: Whenever I hear this song, I remember our holiday by the lake.
items.transformed: Whenever I hear this song, _________ our holiday by the lake.

items.original: I watched it because you had told me it was really good.
items.transformed: I _________ you had not told me it was really good.
items.answer: would not (wouldn't) have watched it if

items.original: He did not talk to anybody before he made the decision.
items.transformed: He _________ before he made the decision.
items.answer: should have talked to someone / should have talked to somebody

items.original: I cannot draw landscapes as well as they can.
items.answer: better at drawing landscapes than me / better at drawing landscapes than I am

items.original: The information I got from them was so unclear that I had no idea what to do.
items.transformed: They gave me _________ information that I had no idea what to do.
